content: The posterior axillary fold is a structural component of the human body that is formed by the latissimus dorsi and teres major muscles. This fold constitutes a portion of the boundary of the axilla, or armpit region. If you are interested in contributing to the development of this topic, you are encouraged to apply for the position of Editor-in-Chief. There may be one or multiple Editors-in-Chief for this topic.
